units.source_text: 又取过粗劣的笔砚来，信手戏书“山城木幡里，原有马可通”的古歌。

en.t: He also took up a coarse brush and inkstone and, on a whim, wrote out the old poem, "In Kohata village of Yamashiro, there was once a road that horses could pass."

units.source_text: 浮舟也在纸上题一首诗：

en.t: Ukifune also inscribed a poem on the paper:
